errors.text_span: Der 18- bis 24-jährige Altersbereich ist in blau dargestellt und erreicht einen Prozentsatz von etwa 22 %.
errors.evidence: The description generalizes the three distinct values for the 18-24 age group (~11% for Germany, ~23% for Netherlands, ~24% for USA) into a single value of 22%. This oversimplification omits the crucial country-specific data which is the main point of the chart.

The description claims the 25-34 age group reaches about 26%. However, the actual values shown in the chart for this group are approximately 13% (Germany), 15% (Netherlands), and 17.5% (USA). The stated value of 26% is significantly higher than any of these and is factually incorrect.
The description states the color for the 25-34 age group is pink ("rosa"), but the color in the chart is purple or mauve.

errors.text_span: Der Balken für die USA ist auffällig länger, da er am Ende der Skala liegt, während die Balken für Deutschland und die Niederlande relativ kurz sind und sich in der Mitte der Skala befinden.
errors.evidence: This sentence is ambiguous and contains inaccuracies. It refers to "Der Balken für die USA" (singular) when there are two. More importantly, it incorrectly claims the bars for the Netherlands are "relativ kurz" (relatively short), when the blue bar for the Netherlands is the second-highest in the entire chart (approx. 23%).

The description completely fails to report the individual data values for each of the six bars. For instance, it doesn't mention that for Germany, the values are approximately 11% and 13%. This omission of the core data makes the description unusable for understanding the chart's specific findings.
